== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：ジャワのキャンプ</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">自分のジャワはすべて戦闘力と没収値が－1。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">ジャワを配備する際、自分のフォースを1消費するだけでよい。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Tatooine: Jawa Camp (Dark)]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. All of your Jawas are power and forfeit -1. Dark Side. When deploying Jawas, you only need to spend 1 of your Force.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Light omits English “here”. Dark spends 1 Force to deploy Jawas and omits “here” and “from you only”. One Light Force icon and one Dark Force icon. White border.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-tatooinejawacamp.gif|Original English face]], [[Tatooine: Jawa Camp (Dark)]].</ref>
